row: Established in 1995, Dr. Hammer and the staff of the Hammer Chiropractic clinic have been offering high quality chiropractic care and rehabilitation services to the greater Milton/Janesville area. Our slogan "caring for you for better health...for your whole family" sums up our constant goal. We are conveniently located off of Highway 26 in Milton, WI.
